constraints: adapted from attributed CLI, stage, and server events; exact coverage is surface-specific
requested model and reasoning settings do not prove effective settings
optional collection and export remain runtime-owned; no Agent Caravan emitter is provided

execution.instructions: Use the selected Agent Caravan execution profile; preserve role, handoff, approval, and termination boundaries. Record the actual provider and model ID.

execution_projection.workflow_construct: one coordinating OpenCode session with explicit stage checkpoints
execution_projection.role_construct: configured agents and child sessions for authorized role lanes
execution_projection.handoff_construct: structured Agent Caravan handoff records linked to OpenCode session references
execution_projection.state_construct: Agent Caravan task, session, and run records linked to OpenCode session state
execution_projection.approval_construct: OpenCode ask permissions and an attributed server/API approval response when human approval is required
execution_projection.degraded_behavior: run only read-only cases through the initial CLI surface; fail closed for writes until a server/API approval-and-resume surface is implemented; use declared serial fallback when parallel timing cannot be proved

fallback_rules: run profile-authorized optional parallel lanes serially in the declared order when native parallel timing cannot be proved
require explicit task summaries when durable memory is externalized
block approval-dependent actions when an attributed approval-and-resume surface is unavailable
